bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
root=/home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/native-sticker-c8c50d420c0b9b5d447a1fc87ef3d9e1ec7aceed
stage="$root/.releases/5aff60b6371f422120398212-album-id-stage"
new=create-videobot:album-id-5aff60b6-tested
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}' 2>/dev/null)" = true || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$(docker image inspect "$new" --format '{{.Id}}')" || exit 62
test "$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=gace-createvdobot --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll -q | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 63
test "$(docker exec "$cid" sha256sum /opt/videobot/src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs | awk '{print $1}')" = "$(sha256sum "$stage/src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs" | awk '{print $1}')" || exit 64

docker logs "$cid" 2>&1 | grep -Fq 'CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS' || exit 66
docker logs "$cid" 2>&1 | grep -Fq 'STICKER_SHOP_HTTP_READY=PASS' || exit 67
cmp "$stage/preserved-before.sha256" "$stage/preserved-after.sha256" || exit 68
echo INDEPENDENT_VIDEO_ALBUM_LIVE_READBACK=PASS
